title: Regional, Rural and Remote Education Commissioner Bill 2018
short_title: Regional, Rural and Remote Education Commissioner Bill 2018

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would create a dedicated commissioner to oversee education, training and research across regional Australia.
The commissioner would advise the minister and develop a long-term national strategy for regional education, training and research.
A draft of the national strategy must be completed within six months of the commissioner starting, with revisions every four years.
changes: Establishes the Regional, Rural and Remote Education Commissioner.
Requires the commissioner to provide advice to the minister on education and training for students outside cities.
Requires the commissioner to create a national strategic framework for regional education, training and research.
Sets a six‑month deadline for the first strategy and a four‑year review cycle.
summary.affected: Students, educational institutions and communities in regional, rural and remote Australia, as well as governments, education providers and industry bodies.
